title: docs(adr): ADR-0150 D3 records the `residual` holder kind

## 维护者速读

1. 改了什么：只在 ADR-0150 的 D3 第 3 步下面加了一条带日期的修订说明（10 行），记录"持有者"词汇多了一种 `residual`（制品顶层、不属于任何包的那部分），以及顶层定时任务按哪个包读取。没有改代码，没有改 ADR 状态行。
2. 为什么改：PR #32567 已经把这个新类别落到代码里，但 ADR 是受管文件，不能混在代码 PR 里改，所以单独用这张卡补记，避免决策记录落后于实现。
3. 风险与回滚：纯文档，不发布任何包，运行行为零变化。回滚就是 revert 这一个提交。唯一的风险是说明与代码不符，所以每个引用的文件和符号都在合并点 `3452dec219` 上逐个核对过。
4. 先看：`docs/adr/0150-behavioural-metadata-addressed-by-package-objects-keep-the-literal-prefix.md` 里新增的那一段，重点看"不拒绝的那一种排列"这一条：它比卡片原文多写了一个例外（见下方 Acceptance notes）。
5. 两分钟验证：运行 `pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors`，预期看到 `3557 anchors across 156 records resolve`，说明新说明里引用的每个文件和符号都真实存在。
6. 需要你做的：审阅并批准（Tier H，`docs/adr/**` 需要人工批准才能落地）。契约复核首轮 6817343212，复审 PASS 6817614982，`Head-sha: d4e67b7bbc13d1e12e87503b19c07054172db497`；席位记录 6817603328。

Fixes #32570

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — ADR bookkeeping only

## What changes

One dated amendment note under D3 step 3 of `docs/adr/0150-behavioural-metadata-addressed-by-package-objects-keep-the-literal-prefix.md` (+10 / −0, one file). It records what PR #32567 (card #32412, merge `3452dec219`) landed:

- D3's holder vocabulary gained the `residual` kind: `{ kind: 'residual', ownerId }`, a stack's residual (ADR-0130 D4), never a `package` holder, named only as a refusal's candidate.
- The record line the epic red-line read 6793085339 (on PR #32410) left for the ADR: what a top-level job outside every package body pulls as, and when a name it shares with a body's job is refused.

No ruled sentence is rewritten, no status line is changed, and no other record is touched.

## Tests

Documentation only: there is no behaviour to test and no ablation is owed. Every `file#symbol` the note cites was read at `3452dec219` (`origin/main` at the time, and the merge commit of PR #32567):

| `…#describePackageScopedHolder` | `export function describePackageScopedHolder` | 347 (the `residual` arm at 350) |
| `…#PackageScopedResolution` | `export type PackageScopedResolution` | 393 (the `Exclude` of `residual` at 398) |
| `…#PackageScopedNameRefusedError` | `export class PackageScopedNameRefusedError` | 592 |
| `packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.ts#jobDeclaringPackages` | `^export function jobDeclaringPackages` | 1136 |
| `…#jobNameRefusal` | `^function jobNameRefusal` | 1195 (the candidates at 1215) |
| `packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts#ReferenceCandidate` | `type ReferenceCandidate` | 159 (the `residual` member at 164) |
| `packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.job-pull.test.ts`, the #32412 describe | its title | 955 |

The only producer of a `residual` holder at that commit is `jobNameRefusal` (`git grep -n "kind: 'residual'" -- packages ui apps`, test files excluded: the type, the `Exclude`, two docblocks and line 1215).

## Gates

Round 2 (contract review 6817343212, S1 + N1), head `d4e67b7bbc`: the same 21 derived commands, 21 of 21 exit 0, `--ran` `21 derived, 21 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (report 6817493998).

Round 1, on head `07568577dc` (`origin/main` `3452dec219` is its parent, so no merge was needed), `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 21 commands. Each was run with its exit code recorded before any pipe: 21 of 21 exit 0. `--ran`: `21 derived, 21 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.

`pnpm check:adr-index` exits 0 and is report-only. It warns that `docs/adr/README.md` is stale. That staleness is already on `origin/main` and is not caused by this note: `pnpm adr:index` rewrites the record count (154 to 155), the Proposed count, the ADR-0106 status cell and adds the ADR-0153 row, and no hunk belongs to ADR-0150, whose title, status and date this PR does not touch. The regenerated README is therefore not committed here; the seat's in-flight README regeneration carries it.

## Acceptance notes

- **The note says more than the card's wording in two places, because the code does.** Both are what PR #32567's own FROM → TO table and the red-line read state, so neither is a contract choice:
  - The card says a name the residual shares with a body's job "is refused". The code refuses it except in one arrangement: the only declaring body is the body that carries the artifact's id (`jobDeclaringPackages`: `declarers.length === 1 && declarers[0] === residual` answers that one package). The note records that exception.
  - The card says the residual's job "runs as" a body or as no package. The binder consults the declaring package for a `pull` job only, as the pull's `callerPackageId`; a `body` or `handler` job does not read it. The note says "pulls as" and states that scope.
- The card's comments add no further amendment row (two comments: the triage record and the Claim).
- The note does not claim that no door answers this refusal. PR #32567 states it, but it is a negative that was not measured here; the note says only where the binder throws it.
- The status line is unchanged, as ordered. The two most recent notes (#32075, #32362) did not extend it either.
- `skip-changeset`: `docs/adr/**` ships in no package.
- Round 2 (contract review 6817343212, S1): bullet 2 now says the refusal is of a job met by name (the residual's own job, and every job of a JSON-loaded artifact); a job object a body's own array holds is met by identity first (`jobDeclaringPackages`) and still pulls as that body. N1: the pins line also cites the [#32071] describe and the [#32355] controls. Delta review 6817614982 PASS.
